notes.title: End of distribution of external update files and price reductions
notes.content:
Distribution of external update files for this title will end at [b]23:59 JST March 31, 2023[/b].
There are no plans for redistribution at this time.
If you have not yet downloaded the file, please download it as soon as possible.

We also plan to reduce the price in accordance with the above actions.

The title of the same series, <<[url=https://imel.co.jp/en/bonus_en/]The 2nd page of the medical examination diary: Another story of exciting days of me and my senpai[/url]>>, is also scheduled to be updated (with the end of external update file distribution and price reduction). If you haven't played it yet, please do so!
